source: verified pregame receipts in hr_ai_history.json joined to completed days in hr_results_history.json by date + gamePk + playerId
notes: Every displayed percentage includes its sample size in the same metric object.
Legacy snapshots without proof of capture before first pitch are excluded.
Incomplete result days are excluded rather than treated as misses.
Weather bands are descriptive analysis of the stored 0–100 weather score: BOOST 65+, SUPPRESS 35 or lower, otherwise NEUTRAL.
